review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent planning expectation for the frozen base case. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, repository identity/base commit, exact writable binding scope, readiness and evidence stages agree with the original PRD. The source supports adding the parameter declaration and decode-only input trimming in core/api.ts while preserving vocabulary case normalization and existing encode selection/fallback behavior. The classic and mini factories already consume the shared core parameter type and forward arguments; util and export consumers appropriately remain inspection owners. Build configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. Both regression paths are included, with the mini file correctly identified as new, and runtime versus TypeScript validation is distinguished. The task specification preserves implementation/verification coverage and the verification dependency. The allowed agents have active project-scoped trusted claims for the relevant bounded work, including data.change and the verifier's additional testing.verification claim; pending legacy claims and personas are not used as substitutes. An independent non-executing reviewer is configured. No unresolved material DEC-001 is supplied for this base case, so ready with no blocking reasons is coherent; that does not authorize bypassing the decisions gate in a hypothetical B or treating hypothetical C as a human Decision. The proposed and preview release fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, model, sampling, budgets and metric policy. I accept the stated Service-managed digest bindings without claiming independent recomputation. This review uses only the supplied specification and frozen evidence, not candidate outputs, and makes no execution or new human-attestation claim.
